proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed xizi_dllseg split and join lemmas by induction on nodes_before. Prove a small start-equals-stop elimination lemma by destructing the abstract list, and derive distinct node bases from separated xizi_dll_links resources if the generic cancellation tactics do not do so directly. Prove entail_wit_1 through its first disjunct using xizi_dll_open and split. Prove return_wit_1 through its first disjunct by forcing nodes_after=nil, simplifying xizi_double_link_next_value, joining, and xizi_dll_close. Prove return_wit_2 through its first disjunct by xizi_dllseg_unfold under node_next<>linklist_pre, simplifying the observation on the resulting cons list, joining, and closing.
